findings.claim: 3 of 38 correctly-paired sealed phases carry a reconcile finding (7%), not 84/189 (~44%). The claim survives; the rate eroded after Phase 275, as #463 predicted.
119 prose-gate statements across 32 SKILL.md; 12 on a runnable line; 11 use || ABORT.
|| ABORT fails closed only if executed as shell: pass short-circuits to 0, fail yields 127 via command-not-found.
32 wiring test files, 29 reading a SKILL.md, all asserting step text; none asserts execution.
Provenance sidecars are HMAC tamper-evidence over agent-written payloads; no gate schema records which checks ran.
Phase 242 shipped an execution-evidence schema and evaluator with two test files, zero artifacts and zero production callers; its plan assigns the producer to execution hosts.
#462 is upstream evidence, #459 an instance in another subsystem, #451 adjacent and weaker, Phase 242 the partial answer.
